actions.description: Read the current value of settings rows (ids as ompdesk_app_list shows after "settings."); all rows when ids is omitted. Secrets are never shown.

Provider usage and quota windows of the signed-in accounts (what the Usage view shows): each window under its own label with percent used and reset time, and the account's saved resets. refresh asks the providers now. device reads another computer's accounts.

device.description: A paired computer by name or id as ompdesk_sessions lists it, or "local"; omit for the omp of your own session.

actions.description: The model role assignments, then the models of the providers that have a signed-in account (each provider's first 40). provider (id), query (words of provider/id) or all: true list whole catalogs, also of the providers without an account (an aggregator's runs to hundreds). device lists another computer's.

device.description: A paired computer by name or id as ompdesk_sessions lists it, or "local"; omit for the omp of your own session.

actions.description: Switch this session's model.
Assign a model to a model role (default, slow, smol, plan, task, ...); omit modelId to clear the role. device sets it in another computer's omp.

device.description: A paired computer by name or id as ompdesk_sessions lists it, or "local"; omit for the omp of your own session.

actions.description: Read stock omp settings (the ones omp itself lists, e.g. retry.fallbackChains, retry.fallbackOn, compaction.thresholdTokens): paths = exact paths, query = words from a path, label or description. device reads another computer's omp. Credentials and the approval, security, memory and computer-use settings are never shown.

device.description: A paired computer by name or id as ompdesk_sessions lists it, or "local"; omit for the omp of your own session.

actions.description: Write one stock omp setting by its exact path (find it with omp_settings.get query). value must fit the setting's type (true/false, number, one of its options, a list, or an object for a record such as retry.fallbackChains). device writes another computer's omp. One step back with app.undo. Credentials and the approval, security, memory and computer-use settings are refused.

device.description: A paired computer by name or id as ompdesk_sessions lists it, or "local"; omit for the omp of your own session.

actions.description: Open a side panel view (terminal, diff, preview, files), open a session view as a sheet (jobs = background tasks, plan = the plan document, logs, tree = the session tree, work = the work tree), or close the panel.
Open Settings at a section (for the user to look at or to finish a step only they may do).
Saved sessions on the computer this session runs on (a paired host's own when it runs there): title, folder, last change, path.

scope.description: local: this folder's sessions; global (default): all.

actions.description: Search the text of saved sessions.

scope.description: local: this folder's sessions; global (default): all.

actions.description: Rename a saved session.
Delete a saved session file for good.

manage.always: deleting a saved session is irreversible

actions.description: Save a diagnostic bundle as a zip file and return its path: stock's /dump archive of an open session plus OMPdesk's own diagnostics text. Anonymized by default (message contents redacted); pass anonymized:false only when the person asked for the raw transcript. Writes to path, else the Downloads folder. Needs the session open in a tab; defaults to this session.

session.description: Session file path (.jsonl) of an open session, from sessions.saved. Default: this session. A session the person hid from agents is refused.

anonymized.description: Default true: stock's /dump anon. false: /dump all, the raw transcript.

path.description: Absolute path of the zip to write (.zip is added when missing). Default: the Downloads folder.

actions.description: Open a macOS Privacy & Security pane in System Settings (Accessibility, Screen Recording, ...). It only opens the pane: the person toggles the switch, you cannot. macOS only.

The projects listed in the sidebar of the computer this session runs on (a paired host's own when it runs there): folder path, name, and whether the folder is gone; for this computer also its pin and its own name. Use the paths with the other sidebar.* actions.

List a folder as a project in the sidebar of the computer this session runs on (the 'Add new project' / open-folder path; a folder removed before comes back). path is absolute. A linked worktree lists its main checkout.

Remove projects from the sidebar of the computer this session runs on, as the project menu's Delete does without its 'also delete saved sessions' box ticked. No folder and no session is touched; opening the folder again in OMPdesk lists it again. path or paths must be listed by sidebar.projects: any other path is reported and left alone.
Pin or unpin a project in this computer's sidebar (the project menu's Pin / Unpin; pinned projects stay on top). path must be listed by sidebar.projects.

path.description: Project folder path, as sidebar.projects lists it.

actions.description: Set the order of projects in this computer's sidebar (what dragging a project does): paths top first, each listed by sidebar.projects. Pinned projects stay above the rest; projects not named keep their place after these.
Give a project its own name in this computer's sidebar (the project menu's Rename; the folder keeps its name). An empty name clears it. path must be listed by sidebar.projects.

path.description: Project folder path, as sidebar.projects lists it.

actions.description: Pin or unpin a saved session in this computer's sidebar (the session menu's Pin / Unpin). sessionPath from sessions.saved.
Archive or restore saved sessions in this computer's sidebar (the session menu's Archive / Restore: they leave the lists until restored; no file is touched). sessionPaths from sessions.saved.
The state of OMPdesk's own update (idle, available, downloaded, ...). host: true reads the paired host this session runs on instead of this computer.

host.description: true: the paired host this session runs on, not this computer. Refused for a session on this computer.

actions.description: Check for a new OMPdesk version now (contacts the release server). host: true asks the paired host this session runs on to check its own.

host.description: true: the paired host this session runs on, not this computer. Refused for a session on this computer.

manage.lifts: only contacts the release server; nothing is downloaded into use or applied (updates.apply asks)

actions.description: Download the OMPdesk update that updates.status says is available, on this computer (what the Download button does). It installs nothing: updates.apply does, and always asks.

manage.lifts: only fetches the release the check found; nothing is installed or restarted (updates.apply asks)

actions.description: Install the downloaded OMPdesk update and restart the app (every running turn ends). host: true asks the paired host this session runs on to install and restart its own; it refuses while work runs there.

host.description: true: the paired host this session runs on, not this computer. Refused for a session on this computer.

manage.always: installs new code and restarts, ending every running turn

describe.text: Install the downloaded OMPdesk update and restart the app (every running turn ends).
Install the downloaded OMPdesk update on the paired host this session runs on and restart that computer's app (its running turns end)
Install the downloaded OMPdesk update and restart the app (every running turn ends).

actions.description: How much disk OMPdesk uses on this computer (worktrees, sessions, logs, stats, app data, session scratch files, the Bun and npm caches) and what the last disk cleanup freed.

Run disk care now on this computer and wait for it: drops build output and dependencies from worktrees idle 3+ days (the project makes them again) and saves then removes worktrees idle 14+ days (restorable from the Work tree view). Nothing the user could lose is deleted.
Quit OMPdesk (every running turn ends).

manage.always: quitting ends every running turn

actions.description: Whether GitHub CLI is signed in and as which login.
Start GitHub sign-in. Only starts the existing sign-in flow (a browser page or a code the person completes); it never reads or stores a credential.

manage.always: signing in connects the person's account (a credential)

actions.description: Start sign-in for a model provider. Only starts the existing sign-in flow (a browser page or a code the person completes); it never reads or stores a credential.

manage.always: signing in connects the person's account (a credential)

actions.description: Whether the phone page is on and its state (the link is not shown).
Turn the phone page on or off (it exposes this computer's sessions to the person's tailnet).

manage.always: turning it on exposes this computer's sessions on the network (turning it off exposes nothing)

actions.description: Install a plugin from a marketplace the person already added (it runs code in every session).

manage.always: a plugin is arbitrary code that runs in every session

actions.description: Erase the user's memory for good: every page, handoff and recorded session.

manage.always: erasing the memory is irreversible

actions.description: Delete one memory page (the Memory page's Restore can bring it back).

manage.always: deleting a memory page erases the person's data

describe.text: Delete the memory page notes/a.md of w/p

actions.description: Run the memory retention sweep for one project (evicts pages the aging rules let go).

manage.always: the sweep evicts memory pages: it erases the person's data

actions.description: Undo the last change you made with ompdesk_app, when it had a previous value.

Change what agents may do: OMPdesk control tools, full control, managing or approving for other sessions, tool approval mode, memory, engineering mode or computer use. Booleans take on; tools.approvalMode takes mode.

manage.always: these switches bound what every agent may do; only full control lets an agent change them

actions.fullOnly: These switches bound the agent's own power. Only the person changes them, in Settings, unless they give agents full control of OMPdesk.

actions.description: Answer an [OMPdesk] confirmation card or a tool approval.
actions.neverReason: A card exists to ask the person. ompdesk_session_answer refuses it too.

actions.description: Read an API key, token, password, proxy credential or the sign-in state of an account.
actions.neverReason: Secrets never reach an agent. Use accounts.*_status for who is signed in.

actions.description: Add an MCP server (stdio: it starts a program; http/sse: it reaches a service). The user sees the exact command or url first. No env or headers: secrets are never set by an agent.

manage.always: an MCP server is arbitrary code (stdio) or a network reach (http/sse) for every session

describe.text: add the MCP server "x" (stdio, user scope), which runs: npx -y x
add the MCP server "x" (stdio, user scope), which runs: npx
add the MCP server "y" (http, project scope), which connects to: https://e.example/mcp
add the MCP server "y" (sse, user scope), which connects to: https://e.example/sse

actions.description: List the MCP servers this session's omp knows: connected or not, tool count, whether it needs a sign-in, and why one is off (turned off, found only in another tool's config, …).

Start the sign-in of an MCP server that needs one (OAuth: a browser page the person completes). Once it succeeds the server connects in every open session, no restart. Only starts the existing sign-in flow (a browser page or a code the person completes); it never reads or stores a credential.

manage.always: signing in connects the person's account (a credential)

actions.description: Use an MCP server that only another tool's user config declares (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, …; extensions.mcp_servers says 'found in <tool>'): copies that one server's definition into omp's user mcp.json. The tool's other servers, skills and rules stay unused.

manage.always: an MCP server is arbitrary code (stdio) or a network reach (http/sse) for every session

describe.text: use the MCP server "docs" that another tool's config declares, in every session

actions.description: List the computers on the person's tailnet as this one sees them (node id, name, login, whether OMPdesk shares it and lets this computer in, and whether this computer already uses it).
Connect this computer to another computer of the tailnet that shares OMPdesk (nodeId from remote.list_tailnet), so sessions can run there.

manage.always: connecting gives this computer's sessions a way onto another computer

describe.text: connect to the tailnet computer nHOST

actions.description: Keep a device that uses this computer out for good (deviceId from remote.devices): its Tailscale node is blocked and it is forgotten. Unblock with remote.unblock.

manage.lifts: it only takes access away, and remote.unblock undoes it

actions.description: Let a blocked device (a computer or a phone) connect again while its Tailscale account is allowed, by its block id or name.

manage.always: unblocking lets a device the person kept out reach this computer again

actions.description: Set the Tailscale accounts allowed to use this computer, from other computers and from the phone page alike (logins; this computer's own stays allowed when the list is empty).

manage.always: an allowed account can use this computer's sessions from any of its devices

describe.text: allow the Tailscale accounts a@b.c, d@e.f

actions.description: List this computer's device name, the paired computers it connects to (hosts) and the devices that use it (peers), with ids and online state.
Change this computer's device name; every paired computer and device sees it at once.
Rename a paired computer this one connects to (deviceId from remote.devices): it changes its own device name. It must be online.
Rename a device that uses this computer (deviceId from remote.devices): it is asked to rename itself, so it must be connected.
Rename a phone or tablet that uses the phone page, by its current name or id.
Read an Autopilot run you started (state, cycle, branch): ompdesk_autopilot status.

Start an Autopilot run: ompdesk_autopilot start, with its own confirmation card (commit, push or release) and its folder rules. ship defaults to the user's stored level; device runs it on a paired device (default the device your session runs on).
End an Autopilot run after the cycle in flight, or with now: true stop it at once (the turn is aborted and the run paused): ompdesk_autopilot stop.

Publish this computer's check-control admission key to a GitHub repository (owner/name): sets its Actions secret CHECKS_ADMISSION_KEY_<device> and adds this computer to the variable CHECKS_ADMISSION_DEVICES, so the queue gate accepts only macOS dispatches this computer's checks hub signed. The key goes to gh on its stdin and is never shown.

manage.always: it changes which CI runs a repository accepts and writes a credential to it

describe.text: publish this computer's check admission key to SeuPut0705/ompdesk (an Actions secret and the device list)
